symptoms.symptom: Dryer shakes or makes noise

causes.label: Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly.
remedies: Move dryer to an even floor space, or adjust leveling legs as necessary until even.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly."

symptoms.symptom: Clothes take too long to dry

causes.label: Improper or obstructed ducting
remedies: Check the Installation Instructions to make sure the dryer venting is correct.
Make sure ducting is clean, free of kinks and unobstructed.
Check to see if outside wall damper operates easily.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Improper or obstructed ducting"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Separate heavy items from lightweight items (generally, a well-sorted washer load is a well-sorted dryer load).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)
remedies: Large, heavy fabrics contain more moisture and take longer to dry.
Separate large, heavy fabrics into smaller loads to speed drying time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)"

causes.label: Controls improperly set
remedies: Match control settings to the load you are drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Controls improperly set"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint filter before every load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker
remedies: Replace fuses or reset circuit breakers.
Since most dryers use 2 fuses/breakers, make sure both are operating.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker"

causes.label: Overloading/combining loads
remedies: Do not put more than one washer load in the dryer at a time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Overloading/combining loads"

causes.label: Underloading eDry is enabled
remedies: If you are drying only one or two items, add a few items to ensure proper tumbling.
The eDry feature is designed to operate your dryer in the most energy efficient mode, which is not always the fastest mode.
In some instances, dry times may be extended to reduce overall energy usage for the cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Underloading eDry is enabled"

symptoms.symptom: The Dry dryness level was chosen but load is still damp

causes.label: Load consists of a mixture of heavy and light fabrics
remedies: When combining heavy and light fabrics in a load, choose More Dry.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Load consists of a mixture of heavy and light fabrics"

causes.label: Exhaust system is blocked
remedies: Inspect and clean exhaust system.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Exhaust system is blocked"

symptoms.symptom: Control buttons not responding

causes.label: Controls accidentally put in service mode
remedies: Press Start/Pause.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Controls accidentally put in service mode"

causes.label: Controls accidentally put in lock mode
remedies: Hold the eDry button for 3 seconds to unlock the dryer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Controls accidentally put in lock mode"

causes.label: Controls performed an incorrect operation
remedies: Reset the in-house breaker.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Controls performed an incorrect operation"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer doesn’t start

causes.label: Control panel is “asleep”
remedies: This is normal.
Press Power to activate the control panel.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Control panel is “asleep”"

causes.label: Dryer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure the dryer plug is pushed completely into the outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Dryer is unplugged"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped
remedies: Check the building’s fuse/circuit breaker box and replace fuse or reset breaker.
NOTE: Electric dryers use two fuses or breakers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped"

causes.label: Dryer was accidentally paused when starting Delay Dry
remedies: If the light on the Start/Pause button is flashing, the dryer is paused.
Press Start/Pause to restart the countdown.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Dryer was accidentally paused when starting Delay Dry"

symptoms.symptom: No numbers displayed during cycle, only lights

causes.label: Dryer is continuously monitoring the amount of moisture in the clothes
remedies: This is normal.
When the dryer senses a low level of moisture in the load, the dryer will display the dry time remaining.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Dryer is continuously monitoring the amount of moisture in the clothes"

symptoms.symptom: Time Remaining jumped to a lower number

causes.label: The estimated time may change when a smaller load than usual is drying
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "The estimated time may change when a smaller load than usual is drying"

symptoms.symptom: Cannot make a selection and the dryer beeps twice

causes.label: The dryness Level, Temp or option that you are trying to select is incompatible with the chosen dry cycle
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "The dryness Level, Temp or option that you are trying to select is incompatible with the chosen dry cycle"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer is running but END is displayed in Time Remaining

causes.label: The Ext Tumble option was chosen
remedies: This is normal.
During extended tumbling, the time remaining is not displayed.
The extended tumbling option lasts approximately 60 minutes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "The Ext Tumble option was chosen"

symptoms.symptom: Clean Lint Filter (message)

causes.label: Power button was activated
remedies: Press Start/Pause to begin a dry cycle and the message will disappear. 49-90585
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 18: "Power button was activated"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer doesn’t heat

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat
remedies: Check the building’s fuse/circuit breaker box and replace both fuses or reset both breakers.
Your dryer may tumble if only one fuse is blown or one breaker tripped.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat"

causes.label: Gas service is off (gas models only)
remedies: Make sure gas shutoff at dryer and main shutoff are fully open.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Gas service is off (gas models only)"

causes.label: LP gas supply tank is empty or there has been a utility interruption of natural gas (gas models only)
remedies: Refill or replace tank.
Dryer should heat when utility service is restored.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "LP gas supply tank is empty or there has been a utility interruption of natural gas (gas models only)"

symptoms.symptom: Inconsistent drying times

causes.label: Type of heat
remedies: Drying time will vary according to the type of heat used.
If you recently changed from an electric to a gas (natural or LP) dryer, or vice versa, the drying time could be different.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Type of heat"

causes.label: Type of load and drying conditions
remedies: The load size, types of fabric, wetness of clothes and the length and condition of the exhaust system will affect drying times.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Type of load and drying conditions"

symptoms.symptom: Glow at the rear of the drum

causes.label: Heaters behind the drum
remedies: This is normal.
Under certain drying conditions and room ambient lighting, the glow of the heaters may be visible at the rear of the drum.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Heaters behind the drum"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes are still wet and dryer shut off after a short time

causes.label: The door was opened mid-cycle. The load was then removed from the dryer and a new load put in without selecting a new cycle
remedies: A dry cycle must be reselected each time a new load is put in.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "The door was opened mid-cycle. The load was then removed from the dryer and a new load put in without selecting a new cycle"

causes.label: Small load
remedies: When drying 3 items or less, choose Quick Dry or Time Dry.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Small load"

causes.label: Load was already dry except for collars and waistbands
remedies: Choose Quick Dry or Time Dry to dry damp collars and waistbands.
In the future, when drying a load with collars and waistbands, choose More Dry.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Load was already dry except for collars and waistbands"

causes.label: Dryer is not level
remedies: Move dryer to an even floor space or adjust leveling legs as necessary until even.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Dryer is not level"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes are wrinkled

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Select a shorter drying time.
Remove items while they still hold a slight amount of moisture.
Select a Less Dry or Damp setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends
remedies: Remove items when cycle ends and fold or hang immediately, or use the Ext Tumble option.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Overloading"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes shrink

causes.label: Some fabrics will naturally shrink when washed. Others can be safely washed, but will shrink in the dryer.
remedies: To avoid shrinkage, follow garment care labels exactly.
Some items may be pressed back into shape after drying.
If you are concerned about shrinkage in a particular item, do not machine wash or tumble dry it.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Some fabrics will naturally shrink when washed. Others can be safely washed, but will shrink in the dryer."

symptoms.symptom: Greasy spots on clothes

causes.label: Improper use of fabric softener
remedies: Follow directions on fabric softener package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Improper use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Drying dirty items with clean ones
remedies: Use your dryer to dry only clean items.
Dirty items can stain clean items and the dryer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Drying dirty items with clean ones"

causes.label: Clothes were not completely clean
remedies: Sometimes stains which cannot be seen when the clothes are wet appear after drying.
Use proper washing procedures before drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Clothes were not completely clean"

symptoms.symptom: Lint on clothes 49-90585

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint screen before each load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Sort lint producers (like chenille) from lint collectors (like corduroy).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Static electricity can attract lint
remedies: See suggestions in this section under Static occurs.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Static electricity can attract lint"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Overloading"

causes.label: Paper, tissue, etc., left in pockets
remedies: Empty all pockets before laundering clothes. 19
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 19: "Paper, tissue, etc., left in pockets"

symptoms.symptom: Static occurs

causes.label: No fabric softener was used
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Bounce® Fabric Conditioner Dryer Sheets have been approved for use in all GE Appliances dryers when used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "No fabric softener was used"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Adjust setting to Less Dry or Damp.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static"

symptoms.symptom: Collars and waistbands still wet at end of cycle

causes.label: The dryness monitor senses that the body of the clothes is dry
remedies: Choose Quick Dry or Time Dry to dry damp collars and waistbands.
In the future, when drying a load with collars and waistbands, choose More Dry.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "The dryness monitor senses that the body of the clothes is dry"

symptoms.symptom: Slight variation in metallic color

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Due to the metallic properties of paint used for this unique product, slight variations of color may occur due to viewing angles and lighting conditions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "This is normal"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer continues to tumble after display says Complete

causes.label: Ext Tumble was selected
remedies: Ensure Ext Tumble option is not selected.
For the Steam Refresh cycle, Ext Tumble will automatically be turned on and cannot be turned off.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Ext Tumble was selected"

symptoms.symptom: Door is too foggy to see clothes during a steam cycle

causes.label: Steam condenses on inner door
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Steam condenses on inner door"

symptoms.symptom: Water seen on inside of door and top of lint filter when opening door after steam cycle

causes.label: Steam condenses on these surfaces
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Steam condenses on these surfaces"

symptoms.symptom: Small areas on clothes are damp after steam cycle

causes.label: Steam condenses on inner drum
remedies: If using the Steam Dewrinkle cycle, manually reduce the cycle time.
If using the Steam Refresh cycle, add more garments to the load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Steam condenses on inner drum"

symptoms.symptom: Dryer makes water noises

causes.label: Water valve is open filling steam generator
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Water valve is open filling steam generator"

causes.label: Steam generator is dispensing steam into drum
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Steam generator is dispensing steam into drum"

symptoms.symptom: Water drips

causes.label: Steam condenses on inner
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Steam condenses on inner"

symptoms.symptom: Cannot see steam at beginning of cycle

causes.label: Steam released at different times in the cycle
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Steam released at different times in the cycle"

symptoms.symptom: Cannot see steam during cycle

causes.label: The steam nozzle might be clogged with debris from your water supply
remedies: Call GE Appliances at 877.959.8688 to order nozzle replacement kit WE25M71 or to request a technician to replace this for you.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "The steam nozzle might be clogged with debris from your water supply"

symptoms.symptom: Garments still wrinkled after steam cycle

causes.label: Too many garments
remedies: Load fewer garments; manually increase time. 49-90585
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Too many garments"
